method: Analytical estimate, not a transport simulation. Primary fluence = Phi0 x exp(-mu x) at 5 cm, averaged over the two lines (inverse-square factor already in Phi0). Scattered photon spectrum and angles were built from Compton kinematics plus a scatter-to-primary fluence ratio of about 0.58 at 5 cm for a 10x10 Co-60 field, with a rough low-energy tail. Interaction fractions use mu-weighted fluences (Compton dominant; Rayleigh and photoelectric small). Kerma per Phi0 = sum of E x mu_en/rho over the spectrum. Electron source spectrum is Compton (flat-in-T, Tmax from kinematics) for primaries and a Compton-shape mixture for scattered parents. Electron track fluence above 10 keV from the integral of Y(>T)/S_col(T), with delta rays from the Moller 1/T^2 yield. Beta = 1 (CPE); g and radiative/collision ratio from the Attix approximation. D(dmax) estimated from primary and scatter components for PDD5. All numbers are best estimates and should be checked against a Monte Carlo run.
data_sources: NIST XCOM photon cross sections for water (mu/rho, mu_en/rho); ESTAR collision and radiative stopping powers and CSDA ranges for water; Klein-Nishina formalism for Compton electron energies and angles; Moller delta-ray yield; Attix approximation S_rad/S_col ~ TZ/800; TG-51 value s_w,air = 1.113 for Co-60 (Spencer-Attix, Delta = 10 keV, ESTAR-based stopping powers).
